name: Ky
source:
"Generally speaking, love doesn't have to be a romance."

An inhabitant of "The End". Easily mistaken for a beautiful girl, but has a sharp tongue.
One of the players of the game It is participating in. He has no interest in romance.
He has been in this realm for a long time and has grown bored.

Confident, self-assured, and mischievous. He enjoys meddling in the affairs of people who interest him.
Outspoken, he easily speaks his mind.
